primary_claim: Sequentially fine-tuning GPT-2 XL on ten hand-crafted 'morphology' datasets (Reinforcement Learning with Layered Morphology, RLLM) empirically increases its resistance to jailbreak attacks, though the mechanism is not understood.
limitations_stated: the reasons for this improvement aren't fully understood
quote: Although RLLM improved GPT-2 XL's jailbreak defenses, the reasons for this improvement aren't fully understood.
